name: tool-grillmaster-homebase-local-bridge-vn4fj8eg
description: Restricted bridge to an explicitly connected private HomeBase installation. Credentials stay in a local memory-only broker. Pair devices and manage secrets in local HomeBase.

tools.name: request
tools.description: Read HomeBase telemetry or send a user-requested supported operation through the owner's local connector. A local connected Anna Agent and an authenticated connector are required. Credentials and security administration are never accepted.

parameters.name: method
parameters.description: GET reads state; POST requests an explicitly permitted operation.

parameters.name: body
parameters.description: Optional operation payload. Never include credentials, passwords or pairing codes.
